notes.title: v1.1.0 is live!
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has played the game!

This is a minor update with some bug fixes, and a few small tweaks.
As requested, I've added additional difficulty levels for the single player Vs AI mode.
Also, I've allowed for more granular tweaking for the music and sound volumes.

Unfortunately, I had to remove support for Thai and Arabic in this update, due to some complexities in the font rendering. I may add them back in the future if there are enough requests.

Please let me know if there are issues!
